messages.subject: Series B raise - engaging Whitfield Carter
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sarah,

Following our call, we'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter on our Series B. We're raising £24m at a £72m pre-money, led by Calderbrook Growth Partners, with Ravensworth following on. Target close is early March.

Could you send an engagement letter and let us know the team? Marcus (CTO) and Rohan (our new CFO) will be your main contacts alongside me.

Best,
Helena

Dr Helena Voss | CEO | Verdant Energy Systems Ltd

messages.subject: RE: Series B raise - engaging Whitfield Carter
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Helena,

Delighted to act. I'll lead, with James Osei (senior associate) running the day-to-day and Elena Marchetti supporting. Engagement letter and our Project Onyx matter number to follow from Donna today.

First steps: we'll review the Calderbrook term sheet, set up the data room and prepare a first draft of the subscription and shareholders' agreement. Could you forward the latest term sheet and current cap table?

Kind regards,
Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
